description_en: Provides a search API operation for the CleverSee AI Search platform. After you create a search application on the platform, you can invoke this search API operation through the corresponding application to retrieve images, documents, and audio/video content in datasets. The platform supports text (natural language), image, or combined text-and-image input, enabling quick adaptation to multi-modal large-scale data search scenarios and helping you efficiently locate target content
description_zh: CleverSee AI搜问平台提供的搜索API接口，支持通过平台搭建搜索应用后，通过应用对应的API调用搜索接口，实现对数据集中图片、文档及音视频内容的精准检索。平台支持文本（自然语言）、图片或图文结合的输入，可快速适配多模态的大规模数据搜索场景，帮助用户高效定位目标内容
kebab_example: aliyun aisearchengine engine-search --app-id 2048962366415007746 --session-id 2e95ef4fbc28437db5008a910bd392a4 --query '{"texts":["女孩收到小红花"],"excludeIds":["id_001"],"pageNo":1,"imageUrls":["https://example.com/img.jpg"],"pageSize":10}' --grey false --user userId=asdfgnoevnor --region cn-hangzhou
name: EngineSearch

parameters.help_en: The unique ID of the application
parameters.name: app_id

fields.help_en:
The text query list.
• Currently, only one text string is supported, with a maximum length of 256 characters
fields.help_zh:
文本查询列表。
• 当前仅支持传入 1个 文本字符串，上限为256字符
fields.name: texts

fields.help_en:
The image query list.
• Currently, only one image URL is supported. The maximum size of a single image is 10 MB. Supported formats: JPG, PNG, WEBP, and JPEG
fields.help_zh:
图片查询列表。
• 当前仅支持传入 1个 图片 URL，单张图大小上限为10MB；格式支持JPG/PNG/WEBP/JPEG
fields.name: image_urls

fields.help_en: The number of results returned per page. Default value: 20
fields.name: page_size

fields.help_en:
The page number, starting from 1.
• Default value: `1`
fields.help_zh:
页码，从 1 开始。
• 默认值: `1`
fields.name: page_no

fields.help_en:
The list of primary key IDs to exclude.
• Purpose: filters out previously viewed history records
fields.help_zh:
需要排除的主键 ID 列表。
• 用途: 过滤已浏览过的历史记录
fields.name: exclude_ids

parameters.help_en: Specifies whether to access the draft version
parameters.name: grey

fields.help_en: The unique ID of the user
fields.name: user_id

parameters.help_en: The user information object (used for subsequent user-perspective analysis)
parameters.help_zh: 用户信息对象（用于后续用户视角分析）
parameters.name: user
